commands: echo "CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR=${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-<unset>}"; echo "PR=1738"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>}"; echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"

git rev-parse --show-toplevel; echo "---"; printf 'RUN_ID=%s
' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID"; printf 'ACTIONS=%s
' "$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; printf 'SKILLDIR=%s
' "$CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
echo "---OVERRIDES---"
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py "prflow:code-reviewer" "prflow:silent-failure-hunter" "prflow:comment-analyzer" "prflow:pr-test-analyzer" "prflow:requesting-code-review" ; echo "ovr-rc=$?"
command -v busybox; command -v gls; echo "---"; grep -c "assert_eq\|assert_" lib/test/modules/create-issue-contract.sh | head
command -v busybox || echo NO_BUSYBOX; command -v gls || echo NO_GLS

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext.out 2>/tmp/ext.err; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "--- STDOUT bytes:"; wc -c </tmp/ext.out; echo "--- STDOUT:"; cat /tmp/ext.out; echo "--- STDERR:"; cat /tmp/ext.err
command -v busybox >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "busybox: yes" || echo "busybox: no"; command -v gls >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "gls: yes" || echo "gls: no"

echo "=== busybox present on this host? ==="; command -v busybox && echo "busybox=YES" || echo "busybox=NO"; command -v gls && echo "gls=YES" || echo "gls=NO"; echo "=== exact-floor test ==="; grep -rn 'exact' lib/test/*.py lib/test/test_module_runner.py 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'floor\|exact' | head -20
which busybox; echo "busybox-rc=$?"; which gls; echo "gls-rc=$?"; ls -la /usr/bin/busybox 2>&1 | head -1
command -v busybox || echo "NO-busybox"; command -v gls || echo "NO-gls"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
